name: sentry-mcp-self-hosted
description: Sentry's MCP server (@sentry/mcp-server 0.42.0, pinned) over stdio for self-hosted Sentry, read-only by default. Off until enabled; prompts for the host and a user auth token kept in secure storage.

sentry_host.title: Sentry host
sentry_host.description: Hostname of your self-hosted Sentry, without scheme or path, for example sentry.example.com

sentry_access_token.title: Sentry user auth token
sentry_access_token.description: User auth token from User Settings > Personal Tokens. Read-only use needs org:read, project:read, team:read, event:read. Add event:write for triage, project:write and team:write for project-management.

sentry_skills.title: Granted tool groups
sentry_skills.description: Comma-separated MCP skills to grant: inspect (read-only), triage (resolve, assign, update issues), project-management (projects, teams, DSNs, monitors, alert rules), seer (needs Seer on your instance).
